# libfobos-sdr-agile

**Host library for RigExpert Fobos SDR boards running the "agile" firmware**

- **Version recorded:** 3.3.0
- **Categories:** `sdr-hardware`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/rigexpert/libfobos-sdr-agile>

## What it does

The host library for the RigExpert Fobos SDR when it runs the "agile" firmware family: the same board, opened through a different API with "agile" controls, a fast frequency-scan mode and automatic receive bandwidth, which the original libfobos does not have. It builds a shared library only here; upstream's four example programs are built but not installed.

## Why you would want it

You do not install it for itself. The SoapySDR module for the Fobos links both libraries, so without this one `soapysdr-module-fobos` will not build, whichever firmware your board runs. Upstream's README says the two libraries can be installed side by side.

## Before it will work

None beyond a compiler and CMake to build it. To use a board with it you need the `fobos-sdr` hardware entry's udev rule and group, and firmware of the agile family: upstream says hardware revisions 2 and 3 need special firmware loaded for it and revision 4 and higher run it natively.

## How it installs

- git (cmake) — https://github.com/rigexpert/libfobos-sdr-agile at `v.3.3.0` (commit `2753965dee361267df86e4a713b8278ad9ae46bb`)
  - build dependencies: `build-essential`, `cmake`, `pkg-config`, `patch`, `libusb-1.0-0-dev`
  - Built on 2026-10-02 in rootless containers the way this block runs it (patch, cmake configure, `cmake --build --parallel 2`, `cmake --install` into /usr/local): debian:13, ubuntu:24.04, ubuntu:26.04 and kali-rolling all exit 0 in about a second with no compiler warnings. The install leaves libfobos_sdr.so, fobos_sdr.h and libfobos_sdr.pc under the prefix. Upstream builds four tools (fobos_sdr_devinfo, fobos_sdr_recorder, fobos_sdr_scanner, fobos_sdr_fwloader) and installs none of them; this unit does not copy them out, so only the library is carried. Built on x86_64 only; arm64 is unmeasured. Not measured: a board.

Files its install rule leaves under the prefix, checked after the run and never copied or removed by the engine:

- `lib/libfobos_sdr.so`
- `lib/pkgconfig/libfobos_sdr.pc`
- `include/fobos_sdr.h`

## Known problems

**The agile and original libraries open different boards.** Both look for USB 16d0:132e, and they are told apart by bcdDevice: this library opens 0x0101, libfobos opens 0x0000. A board running one firmware is invisible to the other library. **This build deletes upstream's udev install rule** (it wrote an absolute /etc path outside the plan); see the patch. The tree is carried as a library only. **Not measured:** everything that needs a board.
